title: Boundary Geometry Determines Optimal Shallow ReLU Approximation under Weighted Coefficient Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2610.36854v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study how boundary geometry affects $L^q$ approximation by shallow ReLU neural networks on convex bodies $K\subset\mathbb R^d$. The target classes are unit balls of weighted variation spaces that can enlarge classical spaces by incorporating domain geometry into constraints on output coefficients. We establish upper and lower bounds for arbitrary convex bodies and determine the optimal polynomial approximation exponents for all planar convex bodies and their products with polytopes, including cubes and circular cylinders. For $C^2$ convex bodies, we determine the optimal exponents in a dimension-dependent range of $q$ extending beyond $2$. When all principal curvatures are positive, the result extends to every finite $q\ge2$. For these classes, the dependence of the optimal exponent on the domain is captured by a single geometric growth exponent associated with small boundary caps. translated_title: 边界几何决定加权系数约束下浅层ReLU网络的最优逼近
translated_abstract: 我们研究边界几何如何影响浅层ReLU神经网络在凸体 $K\subset\mathbb R^d$ 上的 $L^q$ 逼近。目标类是加权变差空间的单位球，这类空间通过将区域几何纳入输出系数的约束中，能够对经典空间进行扩展。我们为任意凸体建立了逼近误差的上界和下界，并确定了所有平面凸体及其与多面体的乘积（包括立方体和圆柱体）的最优多项式逼近指数。对于 $C^2$ 凸体，我们在一个依赖于维数且可延伸到 $q>2$ 的范围内确定了最优指数；当所有主曲率均为正时，该结果可推广到任意有限的 $q\ge2$。对于这些目标类，最优逼近指数对区域的依赖性由一个与小边界帽相关的单一几何增长指数所刻画。此外，我们还确定了保持（性能所需的）锐利权重阈值。
tldr: 本文通过加权变差空间将区域几何纳入输出系数约束，证明边界几何决定了浅层ReLU网络的最优逼近率：最优指数由与小边界帽相关的单一几何增长指数刻画，并为任意凸体、平面凸体、$C^2$ 凸体等给出了精确的最优多项式逼近指数。
